snippet.title: SAFE ZONE Oficial Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
[OFFICIAL MESSAGE – SAFE ZONE CORP.]

Welcome to SAFE ZONE.

[STEAM] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699100/SAFE_ZONE/

This environment has been designed to ensure your well-being... and to put it to the test. Here, death is not a failure — it is part of the process. Observe. Learn. Adapt.

Let MARA, our artificial intelligence, guide you through this series of simulations. Remember: you are not here to survive… you are here to understand.

Are you ready to begin the experiment?

In the end, everything will be okay. And if it’s not okay… it’s not the end.

— SAFE ZONE CORP.

Thank you for your participation.
